sections.Profile:
Sky-Line , produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1965, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. This one-player game features two flippers, five pop bumpers, and dual outlanes, with a unique backbox animation.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Nightclub, Single Player, Wedgehead, Dancing, Nightlife, Original Theme
